# Nathan Cole — Procurement Director, AgriTech Equipment

- **Relationship:** external. Procurement Director at **AgriTech Equipment**, an irrigation-
  equipment OEM and **Brandt's single largest customer** (~**18% of revenue**). Primary contact
  is VP Sales [Gwen Salvato](gwen-salvato.md).
- **Cadence:** quarterly business review; Gwen holds the day-to-day.
- **What he buys:** high-volume pump assemblies from Rockford, on a tight seasonal schedule tied
  to planting season.

## Buried sensitivity — read before any delivery decision
- **AgriTech will churn if a delivery slips.** Nathan has a **hard contractual OTD clause**: two
  consecutive late shipments trigger a **right to re-source**, and he has told Gwen he *will* use
  it — a competitor is actively courting the account. A single missed AgriTech ship date is a
  board-level event, not a plant-level one.
- This is why the [HydraFlow line launch](../projects/hydraflow-line-launch.md) casting-supply
  risk matters so much: Rockford pump output feeds AgriTech.

## How to work with him
- Punctual, unsentimental, metrics-driven. Give him firm dates or none.
